answer: Under 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum) (level AA), a pointer target must be at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels, unless spacing or another exception applies. Under 2.5.5 Target Size (Enhanced) (level AAA), the size is 44 by 44 CSS pixels.

points.text: The AA minimum for a pointer target, including a button, is 24 by 24 CSS pixels.
points.quote: The size of the target for pointer inputs is at least 24 by 24 CSS pixels
points.title: 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum)

points.text: A smaller button can still pass if no other undersized target's 24 CSS pixel circle intersects it.
points.quote: the circles do not intersect another target or the circle for another undersized target
points.title: 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum)

points.text: The stricter AAA criterion requires 44 by 44 CSS pixels.
points.quote: The size of the target for pointer inputs is at least 44 by 44 CSS pixels
points.title: 2.5.5 Target Size (Enhanced)

points.text: A button that is 24 by 24 CSS pixels needs no extra spacing.
points.quote: Since the target size itself is 24 by 24 CSS pixels, no additional spacing is required
points.title: 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum)
points.source_text:
Three buttons are on-screen and the target size of each button is 24 by 24 CSS pixels. Since the target size itself is 24 by 24 CSS pixels, no additional spacing is required, the success criterion passes.
A row of buttons, each of which has a horizontal width of more than 24 CSS pixels, a height of only 20 CSS pixels, and vertical margin of 4 CSS pixels above and below the row of buttons. Since there is sufficient spacing both above and below the row of buttons, the success criterion passes.
Links within a paragraph of text have varying target dimensions. Links within paragraphs of text do not need to meet the 24 by 24 CSS pixels requirements, so the success criterion passes.
